text:
claire: FYI received invoice from Helvetic Dataworks (V-1402) for CHF 12,400. PO notes "vendor requests gross-up for Swiss withholding". attaching invoice_ch_03_2026.pdf
claire: attachment: invoice_ch_03_2026.pdf
tax-bot: Auto-flag: vendor country=CH, service type=marketing/consulting, possible cross-border withholding. Recommendation: request current Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) or withholding applies. Ticket TAX-991 created.
martin: thanks. do we normally gross-up on request? i thought gross-up only with explicit contract clause.
izaac: correct. ops note: vendor submitted a TRC but it's dated 2019 (expired). need a current TRC (issued within last 12 months) or equivalent government confirmation.
jess: for vendor amounts >CHF10k we hold payment until valid docs. propose AP hold code WHT-CHK and 7 business day vendor SLA to reissue.
claire: vendor emailed saying they are mid-application and asked if we can gross-up so they get net amount. they've included a forwarded email from their tax advisor.
martin: we should not auto-gross-up without legal sign-off. can legal do quick opinion? otherwise tell vendor no gross-up, provide timeline + ask for expedited TRC.
jess: i'll draft reply: short + request TRC (pdf), legal cc, explain payment on hold until receipt. include deadline 2026-04-02.
izaac: also request bank instruction confirmation and remind of potential withholding amount (approx 15% of invoice) so vendor can see exposure.
tax-bot: AP hold WHT-CHK applied to invoice VINV-2026-0312. Reminder scheduled 2026-04-03.
claire: sending vendor email now, cc legal. noting internal: create follow-up in Finance Tracker with TAX-991 link.
martin: thanks team. if legal approves an exception we'll route through finance director for gross-up approval and require signed indemnity from vendor.
jess: noted. marking payment run Mar24 blocked for this invoice. :lock:
claire: done — vendor notified. will update thread when TRC received or legal responds.
